name: Sailroof Seal
summary: A sweeping prayer-hall roof rises in one long curve beside a slender minaret, with an eight-point seal inset into the roof.
why: The asymmetric roof flows directly into the hall walls, balancing a straight minaret. A geometric seal occupies a deliberate circular opening, keeping both motif and roof readable in one color. The entrance is centered on the prayer hall.
risk: The seal becomes a simple dot at the smallest size. The sweeping roof is an invented modern interpretation, not a depiction of a specific mosque.
reasonToChoose: You want a modern mosque with a clearly different outer contour.
